answer: Validators that equivocate in a coordinated pattern expose more than k independent claims: pairwise evidence among k identities yields Θ(k²) culpable relationships, so the bonded-escrow penalty grows quadratically. A shared signal links the claims, while a violet audit tag preserves attribution.
